Digital Twin for Asset Integrity in Jebel Ali — NDT Data on a Live 3D Model

Atlantis NDT Digital Twin gives integrity teams in Jebel Ali, United Arab Emirates one 3D model of the asset with every UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT and ET reading mapped to the exact location it was taken. Corrosion rates trend automatically, API 581 RBI scores update as data lands, and API 579-1/ASME FFS-1 Level 1 and Level 2 assessments run against measured thickness instead of a spreadsheet snapshot.

The Jebel Ali asset base this is built for

Jebel Ali is the largest man-made harbour in the world and the operational heart of Dubai's downstream and logistics economy. The Jebel Ali Port (one of the top-10 container ports globally), the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA, hosting Dubai Aluminium / DUBAL's smelter, ENOC's Jebel Ali refinery and lubricant blending operations, the Dragon Mart industrial complex, and the dense petrochemical and chemical-trading cluster), and the Jebel Ali Power and Desalination Complex (operated by DEWA — the world's largest single-site power and desalination complex at 2,800 MW) all anchor a uniquely diverse industrial inspection economy. ENOC's Jebel Ali refinery (210,000 bpd), the Emirates Global Aluminium (EGA) smelter at Jebel Ali, and the Hydrogen Hub investment under DEWA's Green Hydrogen Project at the Mohammed bin Rashid Solar Park (driven from Jebel Ali engineering offices) make Jebel Ali a focal point for downstream, aluminium, power, water, and now hydrogen digital twin programmes. Dubai Municipality, Dubai Civil Defence, and the UAE Federal Authority for Nuclear Regulation frame the regulatory environment.

How the twin is built

Capture the geometry (LiDAR, photogrammetry, drone survey, or import your existing BIM/CAD and isometrics), ingest inspection data over REST API or file drop from any instrument, overlay the governing damage mechanisms per API RP 571, then publish colour-coded remaining-life and RBI views to integrity, maintenance and planning. Records are retained audit-ready under ISO 9001, ISO 17020 and ISO 17025.

Integrations

SAP PM, Oracle eAM, IBM Maximo, ServiceNow, AVEVA PI, OSIsoft historians, Bentley iTwin, Cognite and Atlantis NDT ERP. Full REST API and bulk data export — you keep your data in a format you can leave with.

Frequently Asked Questions

How does Atlantis Digital Twin work in Jebel Ali?

We start with a 3D scan of your asset (drone, laser, photogrammetry), build a CAD-fidelity model, and then overlay every NDT inspection event (UT thickness readings, TOFD/PAUT scans, MT/PT indications, RT defect maps). Inspection data updates the model in real-time and colour-codes condition zones for engineering review. Operators in Jebel Ali use this to drive faster turnaround scoping, automated FFS evidence, and audit-grade regulatory reporting.

What does Digital Twin NDT cost in Jebel Ali?

Atlantis Digital Twin is an affordable, accessible, fully customizable enterprise SaaS platform sized for up to 500 assets, with ASNT Level III consulting and unlimited NDT data ingest included. Enterprise tiers are available for multi-site fleets, and on-prem deployment is offered at the same price point. Request a Jebel Ali-specific quote and we will model your asset count and data-volume requirements.

How long does deployment take in Jebel Ali?

A typical first-asset deployment runs 8-12 weeks: 2 weeks model build, 2 weeks data integration, 2-4 weeks workflow configuration, 2 weeks user training. Multi-asset rollouts are sequenced asset-by-asset after the first deployment is live, with each subsequent asset typically taking 4-6 weeks once the platform is configured for your Jebel Ali site.

Which NDT standards does the platform support in Jebel Ali?

API 510 (pressure vessels), API 570 (piping), API 653 (storage tanks), API 579 FFS, API 581 RBI, ASME Section V articles 2/4/6/7, ISO 9712 personnel qualification, ASNT SNT-TC-1A, and local code requirements depending on Jebel Ali's regulatory environment. Custom reporting templates can be configured for any additional national or operator-specific code.

Can Atlantis Digital Twin integrate with our existing CMMS in Jebel Ali?

Yes. We support REST API hooks for IBM Maximo, SAP PM, IFS, Oracle EAM, and most major CMMS platforms. Work-order creation, asset master sync, anomaly hand-off into corrective work, and FFS evidence packaging for management-of-change submittals can all be automated, allowing your Jebel Ali integrity team to focus on engineering judgement rather than data entry.
